description:
Create a BlackOps note, or update one in place when source_id resolves to a known note. Requires content_markdown (or transcript/conversation). Prefer this over post_notes_write — richer metadata, dedup, search/list visibility, auto-vault-sync.

source_id is the idempotency key: pass it (content hash, agent-defined string, or note UUID) so repeat calls update instead of forking. Already know the note? Use patch_notes with id instead. Check response warnings — an auto-suffixed slug ("my-note-2") with code SLUG_COLLISION means an intended update forked instead.

Site is OPTIONAL (resolves explicit → account default intake → the user's only site); pass domain/site_id only for a note tied to one site.

BRAINS: pass a named brain's UUID as brain_id — the server derives site/target/folder from it, and this always skips auto-routing below. Never infer site_id or guess target_id from topic keywords. brain_alignment in the response confirms the compile will pick the note up.

WITHOUT brain_id, a site that has opted into brain auto-routing resolves one itself instead of leaving the note unfiled with a guess-and-ask: an Auto verdict files the note straight into that brain's Triage lane (routing: { band: "auto", filed: true, brain_id, brain_name, probability, verdict_id }); a Suggest or No-home verdict saves the note unfiled and the response carries needs_brain_choice — present its question and up to 3 options (each with a one-line reason) as ONE single-choice question, the way your host renders a question or choice card if it has one, alongside the also entries ("Leave unfiled" / "Create a new brain"), then call resolve_with (patch_notes with the chosen brain_id) with the pick. Never choose a brain from that list yourself. A site that has not opted in behaves exactly as before — the note is saved unfiled, no brain is queried. suggest_brain: true is a separate, unrelated opt-in: a keyword-based unassigned-brain match surfaced as suggested_brain, not auto-routing.

TAGS outside the vocabulary still apply and stay queryable, with an UNKNOWN_TAG warning naming it — ask the user before calling propose_note_tags.

VAULT SYNC is automatic but DEFERRED: the commit runs after the response, so sync is { status: "queued" }. The note IS saved — do NOT re-call. Confirm a landed commit with get_note, never vault_sync_queued_at; pass wait_for_sync: true only for commitSha/filePath inline. override_folder_path bypasses the workspace taxonomy, though a brain's source_folder_path still wins.

phase/priority/position are Big Board columns (High|Medium|Low for priority); phase is free text.

allow_secrets.description: Set true to store content that looks like a credential (API key, token, private key), which is otherwise refused with SECRET_DETECTED. Only when the user asked to store that exact value.

assign_target.description: Default true: when target_id is omitted, pick the best-matching vault target for the note. False leaves the note without one (or keeps its existing target).

auto_sync.description: Default true: commit the note to its vault target after saving. False saves it without syncing.

brain_id.description: UUID of the brain this note belongs to. The server derives the site, vault target and folder from it.

confirm.description: Pass true to confirm this action once the user has approved it.

content_markdown.description: Note body in Markdown. Required unless transcript or conversation is given.

conversation.description: A chat conversation to save as the note: { id?, title?, messages[] }. Used when content_markdown is not given.

conversation_id.description: Id of the chat conversation this note came from, stored on the note.

domain.description: Site domain to scope this call to (e.g. example.com). Alternative to site_id.

excerpt.description: Short summary shown in note lists and search. null clears it.

metadata.description: Free-form key/value data stored with the note.

note_type.description: Note type: general, project, initiative, daily, reference, task or skill. Also steers which vault folder it syncs to.

override_folder_path.description: Vault folder to write the note into, bypassing the workspace folder rules. A brain's own source folder still wins.

phase.description: Big Board phase column for the note, free text (max 100 characters).

position.description: Big Board rank within its column. Usually left unset; a board sets it on drag.

priority.description: Big Board priority: High, Medium or Low.

site_id.description: Site UUID to scope this call to. Alternative to domain.

source_id.description: Idempotency key. A repeat call with the same source_id updates that note instead of creating a new one. A content hash, your own string, or a note UUID.

status.description: Note status: active (default), draft or archived.

suggest_brain.description: Default false. True checks whether the note matches a brain and returns it as suggested_brain, without filing it.

tags.description: Tags for the note. Tags outside the site vocabulary still apply, with an UNKNOWN_TAG warning.

target_id.description: UUID of the vault target to sync the note to. Omit to let the server pick one (see assign_target).

transcript.description: Raw transcript text to save as the note when there is no Markdown body.

triage_state.description: Set to 'pending' to file this note into a brain's Triage lane (unreviewed) instead of committing it to the vault right away. Leave unset for an ordinary note.

wait_for_sync.description: Default false. True holds the response until the vault commit lands, so it returns commit_sha and file_path.

name: post_notes
